verdict.rationale: The Division names one account layer up front, the Premier Business Services (PBS) account, and offers its own step-by-step videos on setting it up. It also says when that account applies: frequent filers and staff sharing a payment account. Nothing in the evidence lays out a complete list of the account, credential or identity-proofing requirements a founder must clear before filing. missing for 10: an explicit pre-start list of all account and credential prerequisites, any published identity-proofing or verification requirements, a statement of whether PBS or login is required versus optional for a first formation filing, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no undisclosed walls appear mid-flow.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes exactly which account, credential, and identity-proofing steps stand between me and filing — stated before I start, not discovered mid-flow
